VILLAGE_INFO.eyebrow: A little place. A lasting belonging.
VILLAGE_INFO.heroDescription: Welcome to Gautiyan Tola (Saman). A place of familiar faces, shared traditions, and stories that bring us together — wherever life takes us.
VILLAGE_INFO.heroAlt: An aerial view of Gautiyan Tola, with homes nestled among trees and fields
VILLAGE_INFO.aboutTitle:
More than a village.
A feeling of belonging.
VILLAGE_INFO.aboutText: Home is in the little things. A familiar path, a conversation that lasts a little longer, the quiet of the pond, and the joy of coming together. Gautiyan Tola is a collection of these everyday moments.
VILLAGE_INFO.aboutSecond: This is our shared space to keep those moments close. To celebrate the people who make our village special, preserve our memories, and stay connected across generations.
